narrative: He lives in Morton, Illinois. Tim joined us in 2011 and stayed for 3 seasons. Ugh, a Redskins fan. He did ok in the league. He made the Playoffs in his 1st season and went 1-1 then went downhill each year after. Tim drafted Robert Griffin Jr and he went on to win MVP and Offensive ROY and set a record for Most points for a rookie in Season 7. He also won Manager of the Year in Season 7. He was 29-28 during our regular season. He was 5-1 against Creston but everyone beats Creston.
